title: Junior Project Coordinator
rationale: Junior Structural Project Coordinator at a Henderson fabrication and brownfield oil and gas services company; minimum requirement is a trade or engineering qualification, which Marc's BSCE and Advanced Diploma meet, plus a current driver licence, which he holds.

Duties (project documentation, procurement and material management, coordination between stakeholders) match his field engineer and project-in-charge work: tracking procurement and materials, site reports and coordinating engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.
Approximately 1 to 3 years experience is desirable, not essential; fabrication, heavy industry and oil and gas experience are preferred and Marc has none; Perth needs relocation.
caution: No fabrication, heavy industry, oil and gas, marine or Defence experience. Site experience is April 2019 to February 2020 (under one year). Perth move is for Marc to confirm.
gaps: No fabrication, heavy industry or oil and gas experience (preferred)
